mainEntity.name: What is a single-trip travel insurance plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Single-trip travel insurance plans are just what they sound like, travel insurance plans for a single trip. For most people, single-trip coverage is what they need (if you’re traveling often, check out our  Annual Plan ). When you purchase a single-trip travel insurance plan, you’re covering your travel investment from the start to the end of your trip. Travel Guard plans offer coverage helpful for travelers like trip cancellation/interruption coverage, medical expense coverage, rental car coverage and more. And all of our travel insurance plans come with 24/7 emergency travel assistance services, so you can travel knowing you can get assistance any time day or night.

mainEntity.name: What does a single-trip travel insurance plan cover?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Travel Guard offers customizable travel insurance plans for your vacation.  Look for a plan  that has the benefit limits and coverage you need. Popular plan features include:

- Medical expense coverage

- Trip cancellation coverage

- Trip delay coverage

- Baggage coverage

- Car rental coverage

- Cancel for Any Reason (optional add-on coverage available with certain plans)

- Emergency travel assistance – specialized representatives are available day or night for unexpected travel issues

mainEntity.name: Do I need a single-trip travel insurance plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: No matter what type of trip you’re planning, it’s smart to cover your travel investment. The unexpected can happen, even on vacation. So why put your travel plans and investment at risk? That’s why Travel Guard’s Deluxe , Preferred and Essential plans are smart options for your single-trip travel insurance plan needs. Travel Guard plans offer optional add-ons that allow you to customize your plan to fit your specific needs. Plus, all of Travel Guard’s travel insurance plans come with access to our specially trained representatives for  24/7 emergency travel assistance .

mainEntity.name: Which Travel Guard travel insurance plan is best for my single trip?

acceptedAnswer.text: Travel Guard’s  Preferred Plan  is a great option for all travelers. It’s our most popular plan and offers great benefit limits and a comprehensive suite of coverage. It’s also customizable and can be tailored to your specific needs – add Cancel For Any Reason or Travel Guard’s  rental vehicle damage coverage  to create just what you need.

mainEntity.name: How much does a single-trip travel insurance plan cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A travel insurance plan typically costs between 5-7% of your total trip cost. There are several factors at play when pricing your insurance like the product you select and any add-ons you choose. Check out our article on  how much travel insurance costs  for even more detail.

mainEntity.name: Does a single-trip insurance plan cover trip cancellation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, when you purchase a  Deluxe ,  Preferred  or  Essential  Travel Guard plan for your single trip you have coverage for trip cancellation . Your Travel Guard travel insurance plan will cover the pre-paid non-refundable costs of your trip should you need to cancel for a covered reason outlined in your policy. Be sure and read the cancellation policy of your travel providers so you understand the options as you choose the right travel insurance plan for you.

mainEntity.name: Why purchase your single-trip travel insurance plan through Travel Guard?

acceptedAnswer.text: Travel Guard is one of the world’s leading travel insurance providers with a network of service centers located in Asia, Europe and the Americas, ensuring the highest quality emergency travel services and medical assistance while you’re traveling. With early purchase benefits and optional add-on coverages, you can customize the plan and coverages you need for your vacation investment.
